reapi

Real Estate API Integration Client for R

Overview

reapi is a production-grade, robust R package that provides a comprehensive API client library to interface and integrate with Real Estate API. Built on httr2, it offers composable request construction & handling, intelligent caching, and automatic response tidying for seamless integration into real estate analytics workflows.

Installation

Install from GitHub via:

pak::pak("jimbrig/reapi")

Resources

See LINKS.md for an exhaustive list of Real Estate API related resources and URLs.
